observed_signal: Mean reported score 6.13/10, lowest among eight dimensions.
proposed_control_objective: Establish clear accountability for AI systems and their risks.
proposed_control_activity: Maintain an AI system inventory, assign named system owners, define responsibilities through a RACI matrix, document approvals and risk acceptance, and maintain escalation logs.
monitoring_metric: Percentage of registered AI systems with a named owner; percentage with current risk documentation.
suggested_owner: AI Governance Lead / Product Risk Owner
applicability_note: The low relative benchmark score is an investigation signal, not proof of organisational accountability failure.

proposed_control_objective: Make AI system purpose, limitations and behaviour understandable.
proposed_control_activity: Maintain model/system cards, intended-use statements, known limitations, version histories, data provenance and appropriate user-facing AI disclosures.
monitoring_metric: Percentage of AI systems with current documentation and applicable user disclosures.
applicability_note: EU AI Act transparency requirements depend on the actual system, role and use case.

proposed_control_objective: Improve testing of AI behaviour across diverse users and languages.
proposed_control_activity: Create multilingual and code-mixed test suites covering relevant Indian languages, dialects, accessibility needs and representative user contexts.
monitoring_metric: Language-wise test coverage; observed performance gaps between test groups.
applicability_note: Benchmark score does not establish demographic performance for the entire Indian population.

monitoring_metric: Number of identified fairness issues; remediation rate; test coverage by language and scenario.
applicability_note: Selected examples identify test scenarios, not population-level bias prevalence or proof of unlawful discrimination.

control_theme: Ongoing monitoring and AI incident management
observed_signal: The project uses static published benchmark summaries and selected examples; it does not contain live deployment logs or a measured incident-frequency series.
proposed_control_objective: Create a repeatable lifecycle for monitoring AI behaviour and investigating incidents.
proposed_control_activity: Maintain model-version baselines, monitor production behaviour where lawfully and appropriately possible, record incidents, assign remediation owners and retest after significant model changes.
monitoring_metric: Incident acknowledgement and closure time; unresolved issues; percentage of significant changes retested.
applicability_note: This is a proposed operational control. The project does not measure live production incidents.

observed_signal: The benchmark project does not establish that a production deployment processes digital personal data. The control is included for future deployment assessment.
proposed_control_objective: Ensure personal-data processing is appropriately governed where DPDP requirements apply.
proposed_control_activity: Maintain a personal-data inventory; document processing purposes and applicable legal grounds; assess notices and consent where required; apply access controls, security safeguards, retention and breach workflows.
monitoring_metric: Percentage of applicable processing activities with documented privacy review; safeguard review completion.
india_ai_sutra: Trust is the Foundation; People First
applicability_note: Applicability depends on actual processing, territorial scope, statutory definitions and commencement of relevant DPDP provisions. This project is not a compliance audit.

control_theme: AI impact assessment and change management
observed_signal: The benchmark compares multiple dimensions but does not establish system context, intended use or deployment impact.
proposed_control_objective: Assess foreseeable impacts before deployment and when significant system changes occur.
proposed_control_activity: Document system purpose, affected stakeholders, foreseeable impacts, mitigations, residual risks, approval decisions and post-deployment review triggers.
monitoring_metric: Percentage of relevant systems with completed impact assessments; percentage reviewed after material changes.
india_ai_sutra: People First; Accountability; Safety, Resilience & Sustainability
applicability_note: ISO/IEC 42005 is used as an impact-assessment reference. Mapping does not imply certification or conformity.

observed_signal: TRAI released draft AI guidelines for telecommunications on 30 October 2026.
proposed_control_objective: Track sector-specific AI policy developments before relevant telecommunications deployments.
proposed_control_activity: Monitor consultation and final publication; assess whether a future telecommunications AI deployment falls within the guidance; update control mappings when finalised.
monitoring_metric: Policy review status; date of next review; open actions arising from final guidance.
applicability_note: Draft consultation only, with comments invited until 27 November 2026. Telecommunications-specific; not a final general-purpose AI regulation.

evidence_reference: Nine frameworks and policy watch items
observed_signal: The register contains Indian laws, government guidance, an EU regulation, voluntary standards and a draft sectoral consultation.
proposed_control_objective: Prevent inappropriate assumptions about which laws and standards apply to a particular AI system.
proposed_control_activity: Document organisation location, system purpose, actor role, deployment territory, data processed, sector and system classification before assigning regulatory obligations.
monitoring_metric: Percentage of relevant systems with a current documented regulatory applicability assessment.
applicability_note: The project's mapping is preliminary. Actual legal applicability requires facts about the organisation, system, processing, role and deployment.
